---
title: "Subscribe to Marketing in 3"
description: "Get each new issue of Marketing in 3 in your feed reader as soon as it is published: copy the feed address, or follow it on Feedly or Inoreader in one click."
---

```{=html}
<div class="mw-sub">
  <section class="mw-sub-card" aria-labelledby="sub-feed">
    <div class="mw-sub-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 11a9 9 0 0 1 9 9"/><path d="M4 4a16 16 0 0 1 16 16"/><circle cx="5" cy="19" r="1"/></svg></div>
    <h2 id="sub-feed">Add the feed to your reader</h2>
    <p>Pick your reader below, or copy the feed address and paste it into any app that follows RSS feeds.</p>
    <div class="mw-sub-actions">
      <a class="mw-sub-btn" href="https://feedly.com/i/subscription/feed%2Fhttps%3A%2F%2Fschivinski.github.io%2Fwatch%2Findex.xml" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Follow on Feedly</a>
      <a class="mw-sub-btn" href="https://www.inoreader.com/?add_feed=https%3A%2F%2Fschivinski.github.io%2Fwatch%2Findex.xml" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Follow on Inoreader</a>
    </div>
    <label class="mw-sub-label" for="feed-url">Feed address</label>
    <div class="mw-sub-copy">
      <input id="feed-url" type="text" readonly value="https://schivinski.github.io/watch/index.xml">
      <button type="button" id="copy-feed"><svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"/><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"/></svg><span>Copy</span></button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="mw-sub-how" aria-labelledby="sub-how">
    <h2 id="sub-how">What is RSS?</h2>
    <p>RSS is a free, open way to follow websites. Instead of checking the site, you add its feed address to a
      reader app once, and new issues appear there automatically. There is no sign-up and no email address to
      give, and you can unfollow at any time.</p>
    <ol class="mw-steps">
      <li><strong>Choose a reader.</strong> Feedly and Inoreader work in the browser and on phones. NetNewsWire
        (Mac, iPhone), Reeder and Microsoft Outlook (desktop) also follow feeds.</li>
      <li><strong>Add the feed.</strong> Use a button above, or paste the feed address into the reader's
        "add" or "follow" box.</li>
      <li><strong>Read new issues there.</strong> Each issue shows its headline, summary and image, with a link to
        the full article on this site.</li>
    </ol>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var b = document.getElementById('copy-feed'), i = document.getElementById('feed-url');
  if (!b || !i) return;
  b.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var done = function () { b.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(function () { b.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Copy'; }, 2000); };
    if (navigator.clipboard) { navigator.clipboard.writeText(i.value).then(done, function () { i.select(); }); }
    else { i.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); done(); } catch (e) {} }
  });
  i.addEventListener('focus', function () { i.select(); });
})();
</script>
```
